A new interface. The board is redesigned, and each task's page puts everything in one place: the
conversation with the agent, the diff, and a shell in the task's worktree. You can follow what the
agent did, send it a message, and run the tests yourself without leaving the page. Read the
[usage guide](https://github.com/ppoozine/agent-supervisor/blob/v0.4.0/docs/guide/usage.md) for
every screen.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install --force https://github.com/ppoozine/agent-supervisor/releases/download/v0.4.0/agent_supervisor-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl
agsv serve
```

## Highlights

- **Chat**: the task's page opens on the task as a conversation, split into runs. Every entry says
  where it came from: you on the right; the agent and reviewers on the left; automatic instructions
  (failing CI logs, merge conflicts, PR comments) folded in the middle, so you can see exactly what
  the agent was given. Agent messages show their formatting (lists, tables, code), and long
  stretches of commands fold into one line.
- **Shell**: a terminal in the task's worktree, on the same page. One per task; it keeps running
  when you leave the page and ends when the task is archived or the daemon stops. What you type is
  not recorded, and the shell never talks to the agent.
- **Diff like GitHub's**: line numbers in the old and the new file, and GitHub's colors.
- **A redesigned board**, light and dark following your system: a sidebar with each project's
  active tasks, a project filter, and the **Archive** as its own view with outcome filters and
  search.
- **Settings** also shows the limits and the permission policy the daemon is running with, and
  which config file they came from.
- **Cmd+Enter** (Ctrl+Enter) sends a message or starts a new task.

## Changes that affect existing users

- **The Log tab is replaced** by Chat and Events. Events lists every event, filterable by source,
  type and run.
- **The shell runs commands on your machine through the browser.** Its WebSocket only accepts the
  board's own page: the `Origin` header must be present and match `Host`. See the
  [trust model](https://github.com/ppoozine/agent-supervisor/blob/v0.4.0/docs/guide/trust-model.md).
- **New API endpoints**: `GET /api/config`, `WS /api/tasks/{id}/shell` and
  `POST /api/tasks/{id}/shell/restart`. The task detail also returns `feedback_attempts` and
  `max_feedback_attempts`. See the
  [HTTP API](https://github.com/ppoozine/agent-supervisor/blob/v0.4.0/docs/guide/http-api.md).
- **A new dependency**, `websockets`, which uvicorn uses for WebSocket connections.
- The config file, the data directory and the database are unchanged; 0.3 data keeps working.

agent-supervisor is at 0.x: the adapter interface, the HTTP API, the config file, and the database
schema may change in any minor release.
